name: にちか
text:
いやいやいやいや……！
ないですないですー……
trans:
Nonono, no way...!
Absolutely not goinggg...!

name: 放送作家
trans: Huuuh?!

name: にちか
text:
ないですってー、ないない
だって、えっ、外いま何度くらいかわかってます？
trans:
No way, just, no! I mean, why?!
Do you have any idea what's the
current temp outside?!

name: 放送作家
text:
えー？　待って待って
気温……今……────
trans:
Huuuh?! M'kay wait, give me a sec...
Current... temperature......

name: 放送作家
trans: —It's currently 9°C!

name: にちか
text:
いや９度で夜の公園座ってろとか軽くお仕置き
じゃないですかねー？
trans:
Nah, sitting in the park in the middle of the night
when it's 9°C outside—isn't that lowkey torture?!

name: ラジオディレクター
text: あははっ、そんなふうに言っちゃうとさー？
trans:
Ahaha! I mean, when you
say it like that, y'know...?

name: 放送作家
text:
そうだよー、お花見だよぉ？
あたしの手作りタコさんウインナーもあるんだよぉ！？
trans:
Riiight! We're just gonna view the blossoms!
You can even have some of my homemade
octoweiners, you know?!

name: にちか
trans:
That doesn't really—!
Wait...

name: にちか
text:
２分咲きだかなんだかの木の下でごはん食べても
それはただ夜の公園でご飯食べてる人たちですよ……！
trans:
If we go there to see some barely blooming flowers
or whatever and eat under a tree, that'd be no
different from a normal park picnic!

name: 放送作家
text:
もうー！　うそでしょー
絶対七草ちゃんは来てくれると思ったのにー……！
trans:
Aw, c'mooon! You gotta be kidding meee!
I thought you'd definitely come with us,
Nanakusa-chaaan...!

name: にちか
text: それ別の七草ちゃんですねー
trans:
Must've been thinking of a
different Nanakusa-chan, theeen.

name: ラジオディレクター
trans: Yup, can't win over this one.

name: 放送作家
text:
えー……！
プロデューサーくんだって来────
trans:
Huuuh?!
But, even your Producer-kun is goi—

name: 美琴
trans: Great job today.

name: 放送作家
trans:
——!
Mikoto-chan...!

name: にちか
trans: Oh, good work toda—

name: 放送作家
text: 美琴ちゃんは行くよねぇ……！？
trans: Mikoto-chan, you WILL go with us, right...?!?

name: 美琴
trans: —Hm?

name: ラジオディレクター
text:
今日終わってからすぐなんだよね
うちんとこのディレクターとクライアントさんも何人かいて
trans:
We'll be going right after today's job ends.
Our director here, as well as the clients and
some other people will be tagging along too.

name: にちか
trans:
...Hehe,
Boohoo! Too bad for yo—

name: 美琴
trans: Sure.

name: にちか
trans: ...Wha—

name: にちか
text: あっ、あの……ぜんぜん、えっと────
trans:
Ah, um...
Nevermind! Uhh—

name: 営業部スタッフ
text:
いやぁ２８３さん、お久しぶりー！
今日いると思わなくてぇ────
trans:
Maaan, long time no see, 283-san!
Never thought you'd pop up today—

name: スポンサー
text: ……って話だったんだけど、ウチもほら去年────
trans:
...is what we've talked about, but, you see,
next year we'll also be—

name: にちか
trans:
......
Haaaaah...

name: 事業部長
text:
ワハハッ
もうそこはねぇ、エイヤでアレしてホラ────
trans:
Wahaha! For that part, ya see, we just
did a bit of fiddling around, and—

name: アナウンサー
text:
ピアスかわい～！！
ね～美琴サンてそういうのどこで買っ────
trans:
Your earrings are sooo cute～! Hey～
Where did you buy those from, Mikoto-sa—

name: 放送作家
text:
────はい、七草ちゃん
タコさん特盛りおかわり～♡
trans:
—Here you go, Nanakusa-chan.
A lovely heaping of octoweiners～♡

name: 放送作家
text: あ、ジュースも飲ませてあげまちゅよ～
trans: Oh, I'll have you drink some juice too～!

name: にちか
text:
────っ
自分で飲みますー。もさもさするのばっかだなー……！
trans:
—Ah! I can grab my own driiink!
You really love ruffling my hair...!

name: ラジオディレクター
text:
────へぇ、緋田さんあのへん行くなら
僕もちょっとお勧めあって────
trans:
...Hmm, if you're gonna go there, then I have
some recommendation for you too, Aketa-san—

name: にちか
trans: ——ah.

name: AD
trans: Worried about Aketa-san?

name: にちか
trans: ——Huh?!

name: AD
text:
今日モテモテっすよね～
オレもお隣狙ってんすけど、なかなか～……
trans:
She's insanely popular today, isn't she～?
I've been trying to sit next to her too,
but the battle's been quite fierce......

name: AD
trans: Do you think she likes flowers?

name: にちか
trans:
......Uh.
W-Who knows......?

name: にちか
trans: like.

name: にちか
trans:
does she,
really?

name: AD
text: ────静かに見上げてる感じ、美麗っすわ～……！
trans:
—She's really insanely gorgeous when
she silently looks upwards like that～!

name: 営業部スタッフ
text:
────ハーイ、そんじゃ二次会行かれる方
駅前なんで移動お願いしますねー
trans:
—Okaaay, for those who are coming to the
after-party, please gather in front of the
statiooon.

name: 事業部長
text:
では恒例の一本締めで～
みなさん本年度もどうぞよろしくお願いしまーす
trans:
Well then, let's end this with our usual closer!
Everyone, please continue to work together
with us this year toooo!

name: 事業部長
trans: One, two—!

name: 参加者ら
trans: Thanks for all the hard work this yeaaar～!

name: にちか
trans:
......
Mikoto-san—

name: にちか
trans:
—Ah!
M-Mikoto-san......!

name: 美琴
trans: ...Great job today.

name: にちか
trans:
S-Same to you...!
Um...!

name: 美琴
text:
少し待たなければいけなそう
プロデューサー、挨拶に回ってるみたいだから
trans:
Seems like we still have to wait here for a bit.
Producer seems to be going around exchanging
greetings with people.

name: にちか
trans:
Ah...
Looks like it, yeah...!

name: にちか
trans: Cherry blossoms.

name: にちか
trans:
N-Nothing... it's just, um...
—did...

name: にちか
trans: Did you have fun...?

name: にちか
text: その、桜っていうかお花見っていうか……
trans:
Err, I mean, with the cherry blossoms,
like, the viewing and all that stuff...

name: 美琴
trans: ......I wonder.

name: 美琴
text:
不思議だね
こんなに冷えているのに……
trans:
Intriguing, isn't it?
It's freezing outside, and yet...

name: 美琴
text: どうして、公園でごはんを食べるの
trans: Why exactly, do we have to eat outside in a park?

name: 美琴
text:
……私、打ち合わせか何かが
あるのかと思っていたから
trans:
...I just thought maybe we'd have
a meeting or something, so I went.

name: にちか
text: それはただ夜の公園でごはん食べてる人たちですよ……！
trans:
...that'd be no different from
a normal park picnic!

name: 美琴
text: この後スタジオ、入れる？
trans:
You think you can go to
the studio after this?

name: off
trans: Cherry blossoms.

name: にちか
trans: ——Absolutely...!
